items.title: How to make four specialist AI agents act as one trusted financial advisor
items.summary: When you split a banking assistant into specialist AI agents on separate runtimes, they lose their shared state. This post shows architects how we built the Connected Finance demo on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: carrying shared context across runtimes, discovering specialists at runtime, and applying one set of guardrails to voice and text.
items.creator: Eduardo Patrocinio
